ModSporeling.name: Sporeling
ModSporeling.attack: Puff a short cloud of poison spores
ModSporeling.special: Scatter: shake two seeds out of your cap
passive: Seeds next to you ripen much faster
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModThornbiter.name: Thornbiter
ModThornbiter.attack: Long vine whip that may bleed
ModThornbiter.special: Root Run: roots race at the hero and root him
passive: Your roots plant a seed where they stop
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModRotfly.name: Rotfly
ModRotfly.attack: Spit a poison glob, mid range
ModRotfly.special: Buzz Bomb: dive, burst a poison puff, climb back
passive: Spit that misses lands as a seed
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylSporeHusk.name: Spore Husk
ModSylSporeHusk.attack: Two smashes, then a quake that shakes out seeds
ModSylSporeHusk.special: Spore Belch: a wide cone of poison spores
passive: Your smash bursts every ripe pod nearby
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModBloomWitch.name: Bloom Witch
ModBloomWitch.attack: Two lances, then three that bloom into spores
ModBloomWitch.special: Graft a ripe pod onto your kin and yourself
passive: Graft ripe pods onto your kin's heads
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModBrambleKnight.name: Bramble Knight
ModBrambleKnight.attack: Thorn sweep, then a drive that plants a thorn line
ModBrambleKnight.special: Overgrow: four thorn patches burst up round you
passive: Your sweep's tip plants a thorn patch
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylStrangler.name: Strangler Vine
ModSylStrangler.attack: Two bites, then a lunge whose coils hold him
ModSylStrangler.special: Lasso a pod or seed near you and sling it at him
passive: Lasso a pod and sling it at him
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylStrangler.vault: A braided vine serpent. It lassoes ripe pods and slings them at its prey

ModSylGallWasp.name: Gall Wasp
ModSylGallWasp.attack: Three needles a beat apart; the middle one sows
ModSylGallWasp.special: Dart through the hero, dropping two seeds
passive: Your seeds ripen faster
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylBloatfly.name: Bloatfly
ModSylBloatfly.attack: Two bile retches, then a glob that bursts in five
ModSylBloatfly.special: Bile Rain: retch straight down on him; steer it
passive: In your bile, his poison lasts longer
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylBloatfly.vault: Retches bile from on high. Poison lingers on whoever stands in it

ModSylBriarBehemoth.name: Briar Behemoth
ModSylBriarBehemoth.attack: Two tusk hooks, then your bush whips round too
ModSylBriarBehemoth.special: Charge; your bush swings in as you stop
passive: Your dragged bush swings in when you turn or stop
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylBriarChampion.name: Briar Champion
ModSylBriarChampion.special: Lunge: plant your feet and thrust further
passive: Each hit grows your lance. Each hit taken trims it
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylBriarChampion.vault: Its thorn lance grows with each wound it deals and shrinks when it is hit

ModSylPuffball.name: Puffball Brute
ModSylPuffball.attack: Two spore slams, then a ring that rolls on ahead
ModSylPuffball.special: Bounce through the hero and land in a spore ring
passive: Knocked into a wall, you bounce back at him
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylPuffball.vault: Light as a puffball. Struck into a wall, it bounces straight back

ModSylCordyceps.name: Cordyceps Saint
ModSylCordyceps.attack: Two spine flicks, then a volley of three
ModSylCordyceps.special: Spines seed stalks that drag him in, then burst
passive: Infect your kin: they fight on after death
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylCordyceps.vault: Its spines seed stalks that drag the host in, then fruit

ModRotMother.name: The Rot Mother
ModRotMother.attack: Roots erupt under him; the third run races at him
ModRotMother.special: Sprouting: three Sprouts burst up round the hero
passive: Each pod that bursts on him heals you
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylNightshade.name: Nightshade
ModSylNightshade.attack: Two berries that split, then a handful of three
ModSylNightshade.special: Shade Garden: hide your pods, plant two by him
passive: Your pods go unseen a while. He has to guess
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylNightshade.vault: Hides the orchard's pods from sight, and tosses berries that split in three

ModSylPollenMonarch.name: Pollen Monarch
ModSylPollenMonarch.attack: Claps of three and five darts, then a pollen gust
ModSylPollenMonarch.special: Pollen Storm: a wide cloud ahead, and four seeds
passive: Dusted, he sets off pods from further away
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylSower.name: The Sower
ModSylSower.attack: Two seed shots, then a harvest: his pods burst
ModSylSower.special: Strafe across his front, sowing a row of seeds
passive: Seeds from one pass burst together
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylSower.vault: A hornet with a drill for a belly. It plants a row in one pass

ModSylCarrionLily.name: Carrion Lily
ModSylCarrionLily.attack: Bites that breathe rot; the third breathes three
ModSylCarrionLily.special: Corpse Bloom: a wide cone of rot
passive: Planted, you heal and reach far. Uproot to move
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylBriarWyrm.name: Briar Wyrm
ModSylBriarWyrm.attack: Mace front and back; the third flings thorns
ModSylBriarWyrm.special: Thorn Spiral: spin out thorns in two arms
passive: Your mace hits in front, then behind you
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylBriarWyrm.vault: A bramble serpent whose mace-tail strikes before it and then behind it

ModSylBlightBellows.name: Blight Bellows
ModSylBlightBellows.attack: Two bouncing bladders, then a pair round him
ModSylBlightBellows.special: Gas Lanes: pump three lanes of gas; turn between
passive: Your bladders bounce three times, puffing gas
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylBlightBellows.vault: A wheezing bellows on wings. Its gas hangs in the air longer

ModSylCarrionQueen.name: Carrion Queen
ModSylCarrionQueen.attack: Two stabs, then a lunging stab that heals you
ModSylCarrionQueen.special: Proboscis Dive: a long dive you steer
passive: Your drone keeps dazing him: stay close
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylCarrionQueen.vault: A fly queen whose droning wings daze anyone caught in the ring

ModSprout.name: Sprout
ModSprout.attack: Puff a tiny poison spore cloud
ModSprout.passive: Burst up through the floor round the hero

ModSylShambler.name: Shambler
passive: You stagger on a moment, then burst into seeds
ModSylShambler.vault: A corpse the cordyceps won't let die. It staggers on, then bursts into seeds
